name: copilot-workspace
description: Setup and sync GitHub Copilot configuration from GravionLabs/copilot-hub. Provides an interactive wizard (gh-copilot-setup) to bootstrap .github/ with instructions, prompts, and agents tailored to your stack, plus a sync prompt (gh-copilot-sync) to keep them up to date. The standalone copilot-sync.ps1 script is included for manual or scheduled runs without the AI prompt.
